title: Emergent Spacetime in Quantum Gravity
bottleneck: Holography and tensor-network models suggest spacetime itself emerges from quantum entanglement, but there is no complete derivation of an expanding cosmological spacetime — let alone ours — from microscopic degrees of freedom. AdS/CFT works for anti-de Sitter space, which has the wrong cosmological constant sign for our universe. Tensor networks reproduce spatial geometry in toy models, but extending them to Lorentzian, expanding cosmologies is an unsolved challenge.
why_it_blocks: Without a cosmological emergence mechanism, quantum gravity cannot claim to explain the spacetime we inhabit. Progress here is slow because there is no experimental feedback to guide the mathematics.
current_state: dS/CFT and related programs are programmatic, not predictive; no emergent model reproduces LambdaCDM cosmology. Progress is conceptual rather than predictive, with no near-term prospect of cosmological tests.

sources.title: On the Impossibility of Precise Verification of Models of Quantum Gravity (arXiv:2309.07203)
